info.title: dvdrift - deterministic diff and accountability reports for Dataverse solutions
info.description: Know what changed in a shared Dataverse environment, who changed it, and what was left running. Deterministic.

options.name: --summary-only
options.description: Emit just the counts line, without the per-component tables

options.name: --out
options.description: Write report to file instead of stdout

options.name: --config
options.description: Config file (default: dvdrift.json in working directory if present)

options.name: --fail-on-change
options.description: Exit 1 if any change is detected

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the installed version
ATTRIBUTION (requires --url and either a token or client credentials):

options.name: --access-token
options.description:
Pre-acquired access token (env: DATAVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN)
Without --offline or --url, the diff succeeds without attribution/state
and writes a warning to stderr.
EXIT CODES:
0  no gating condition hit
1  changes detected and --fail-on-change set
3  usage or runtime error

arguments.name: BASELINE
arguments.description: Baseline snapshot: solution .zip, raw zip-extract folder, or pac-unpacked folder
